# Vendored REALITY rustls

This directory contains the `cfal/rustls` source at commit
`d17d0fc304c03fe6e2c96ade6cd39c33b951c3af`.

It is intentionally consumed only through the `rustls-reality` path
dependency in the repository root. The ordinary TLS and ACME paths continue
to use the upstream `rustls` crate from crates.io.

The upstream project licenses are preserved in this directory.
